body.name: Supplied-order lower-bound handle
body.construction: Starting move: take the incidence-path decomposition in the Set Cover reduction of Lampis, assign one recurring residual value to each live boundary element, and order Gaussian components by the source bags. Before using any component as a Gaussian gadget, certify its piecewise covariance \(M_{xx}=\widetilde a_x\) and off-diagonal path products by an arbitrary-root SEM derivation, check both directed residuals on every edge, positive definiteness, nonzero-edge faithfulness, rationality, and polynomial bit length; then prove that private realization labels never cross a cut and every unsatisfied obligation forces a new selected label.
